channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Arista
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Arista, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now (update): Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: SQL Injection
item.description:
Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: SQL injection · low-privileged account · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10, 6.4.2.12 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator to the fixed version for your release line (for example 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10 or 6.4.2.12).

Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-114625

item.title: Keep patched: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: Improper Input Validation
item.description:
Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: exploited from day 0 · fix: 5.2.3.16, 6.4.2.8

First step: Update Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator to 5.2.3.16 or 6.4.2.8 or later.

Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-93952
